resources.string: Enter the credentials to get started.
Addon address (only this device can reach it):

First time for a video with no subtitle in your language: RightSubs reads a little of the video and translates with DeepL, which takes 20 to 60 s. Since Stremio gives up after 10 s, the video opens with a provisional subtitle that says so: leave the video, open it again after about 30 s and the translated subtitle shows up. From the second time on it is instant.

Install the addon with the button above: on a phone it opens Stremio Web in the browser; on a TV, open Addons › Add addon in Stremio and type the address. Then uninstall OpenSubtitles v3 so RightSubs is the only subtitle source. The service starts by itself when the device turns on.
In Stremio, open Addons › Add addon and type %1$s (tip: the Google TV app keyboard on your phone can paste)
Address copied. In Stremio, open Addons › Add addon and paste: %1$s

Primary and secondary are the subtitles you watch: for Stremio to pick RightSubs\' by itself, Stremio\'s subtitle language must be the same as the primary. The reference never shows on screen: it only helps get the timing right (most subtitles made for each file are in English).
The secondary must differ from the primary
OpenSubtitles: create a free account at opensubtitles.com. The API key is under profile › API consumers › New consumer (tick “Allow anonymous downloads”).

The data stays on this device only, encrypted with an Android Keystore key that never leaves it, and is sent only to OpenSubtitles, Real-Debrid and DeepL. It is not shown again once saved. Tip: to type on your phone, use the Google TV app keyboard.
Real-Debrid (optional): with the token, RightSubs finds the video that is playing and syncs even without an exact subtitle. Token at real-debrid.com/apitoken.

DeepL (optional, last resort): translates a subtitle from another language into yours when there is none in the primary or secondary. Free key at deepl.com, under Account › API Keys (it ends in “:fx”).
On a phone connected to the same Wi-Fi network as this TV, point the camera at the QR code or open the address below in the browser.
The form stays open for 10 minutes and closes after one submission. The data travels over your Wi-Fi network (protected only by the Wi-Fi password) and is stored on this TV only.
QR code with the form address

Invalid OpenSubtitles API key (letters and numbers only).
Use the OpenSubtitles username, not the e-mail.
Invalid Real-Debrid token (copy it from real-debrid.com/apitoken).
Invalid DeepL key (copy it from deepl.com, under Account › API Keys).
The credentials go straight to the TV over your Wi-Fi network and are stored on it only.
A blank field keeps the value saved on the TV.
Done! The credentials were saved on the TV and the addon is restarting. You can close this page.
Wrong code: check the one shown on the TV.
Wrong code too many times. Create another form on the TV.
